exposure: maternal serum vitamin D status (deficient, insufficient, sufficient, normal)
cohort: The study included 2483 participants from the Amsterdam Born Children and their Development prospective cohort.
finding: Vitamin D deficiency was associated with increased postpartum anxiety symptoms in the overall cohort, and with increased postpartum depressive and anxiety symptoms in women not taking vitamin D supplementation.
gest_age: Maternal serum vitamin D and CRP were measured at a median of 13 weeks' gestation.
